focus: Preprocessing, patient-level split, and MONAI-ready dataset construction

preprocessing_policy.scientific_boundary: Panels are validated intra-DICOM candidate pairs, not confirmed ground-truth B-mode/CEUS modality labels.

scientific_boundary: The dataset is suitable for AI pipeline development and MONAI loader testing. It should not be interpreted as clinically validated modality labels, stiffness measurements, or biomechanics parameters.
